race.comment: SURELY SPECIAL (6) chases three on the bounce. That was when he got back to this sort of distance. The last victory was a huge one. He must have done well to be backing up so quickly. He might be 9yo but obviously this is career best form. PALACE WINTER (9) is an interesting runner going straight to this trip. He has had a few trials to be ready and bred to want every bit of it. Does want it dry. OPUS (7) had things not go to plan when last racing at Wodonga. Before that, he was in winning fettle. Betting will be a good guide. UP AND UNDER (4) should be better going up in trip. It was a decent effort last run though.
